A Master's degree (Religious Studies) with 55% marks having National Eligibility Test (NET) or awarded a Ph.D. degree

qualification.details: A Ph.D. degree from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. | Preference to candidates with a keen interest in Sri Guru Granth Sahib, Sikh Studies and Religious Studies and a minimum of 10 years of teaching and research experience. | A minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at the Master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment. A 5% relaxation at the Bachelor's and Master's level is allowed for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes (Non-creamy Layer) and differently abled candidates, for eligibility and for assessing good academic record. It applies to qualifying marks only, without any grace marks. A 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) applies to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991. A relevant grade regarded as equivalent of 55% at the Master's level, where a recognised university follows a grading system, is also valid. Time taken to acquire an M.Phil. and/or Ph.D. is not counted as teaching/research experience. Active service spent on a research degree alongside teaching, without taking any leave, is counted as teaching experience. Good academic record means at least 2nd class with 50% marks at graduation level. | The notice also states that, in rare cases where UGC NET qualified candidates are not available, candidates with a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject (minimum 55% marks) shall be considered for appointment. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

salary_details.pay_scale: UGC NET qualified: Rs. 45,000 per month fixed; Non-NET qualified: Rs. 35,000 per month fixed

how_to_apply: Apply in online mode only through the Guru Nanak Dev University website, www.gndu.ac.in. Applications by post, email, fax or deposit of CV are not accepted.

Keep these details ready before starting: personal details including date of birth and nationality, mobile number, valid email ID, reservation category details, percentage of educational qualification from Matriculation onwards (calculate percentage from CGPA/OGPA in advance), and scanned photograph and signature.
Register once by filling the Registration Form, even when applying for more than one post, department or campus. Apply separately for each post earmarked for each department.
Fill the Score Card Proforma for Assistant Professor, an essential component of the online application form.
Upload the photograph and signature in JPEG format, each not more than 100 kb.
Pay the fee online by credit card, debit card or net banking, and complete all registration steps by 1 December 2026.
Take a printout of the online application form and affix the same passport size photograph that was uploaded.
Attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 with the hard copy of the application form. Report at least an hour before the scheduled time of 11:30 A.M. No separate call letters will be issued.
SC/ST and PWD candidates who are not domicile of the State of Punjab pay Rs. 1180 (including GST). The fee is non-refundable and is not held in reserve for any other recruitment or selection process.

Walk-in interview: 4 December 2026, 11:30 A.M. Venue: Office of Dean, Academic Affairs, Senate Hall Building, Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar. The interview schedule is also on the University website. The merit list will be prepared, and the screening criteria and template used by the Selection Committee for academic record and research performance are available on the University website. Bio-data of any candidate can be placed before the Selection Committee.
Technical enquiry about the online form: Phone No. 0183-2258802-09 (3182). General enquiry about the advertisement: 3099. Timing is 9.00 A.M. to 5.00 P.M. on working days.
important_instructions: Candidates already in service may be allowed to appear in the interview without a No Objection Certificate if they give the undertaking; if selected, no extension in joining time is allowed. No additional paper or document that was not part of the original application may be presented before the Selection Committee. Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained. Applying and meeting the essential qualification does not give any right of appointment. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. Wards/wife of Ex-servicemen can apply under the Ex-servicemen category. Ex-servicemen or Lineal Descendants of Ex-Servicemen (LDESM) with Punjab domicile must produce a certificate from the District Defence Services Welfare Officer/District Sainik Welfare Officer. LDESM are considered only if sufficient Ex-servicemen are not available; otherwise they are treated as General Category. Candidates need a valid email ID active throughout the process and should check the Inbox and Spam box and the University website regularly. Newspaper notification is not obligatory on the University. Disputes are subject to the courts/tribunals having jurisdiction of Amritsar.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: A Ph.D. degree from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Preference to candidates with a keen interest in Sri Guru Granth Sahib, Sikh Studies and Religious Studies and a minimum of 10 years of teaching and research experience. A minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at the Master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment. A 5% relaxation at the Bachelor's and Master's level is allowed for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes (Non-creamy Layer) and differently abled candidates, for eligibility and for assessing good academic record. It applies to qualifying marks only, without any grace marks. A 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) applies to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991. A relevant grade regarded as equivalent of 55% at the Master's level, where a recognised university follows a grading system, is also valid. Time taken to acquire an M.Phil. and/or Ph.D. is not counted as teaching/research experience. Active service spent on a research degree alongside teaching, without taking any leave, is counted as teaching experience. Good academic record means at least 2nd class with 50% marks at graduation level. The notice also states that, in rare cases where UGC NET qualified candidates are not available, candidates with a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject (minimum 55% marks) shall be considered for appointment. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contractual basis for the session 2026-27. The notice states "As per UGC Guidelines strictly" for the qualifications. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Persons already in service who are selected get the standard joining time of one month from the issuance of the appointment letter, with no extension. The University verifies antecedents and documents at the time of appointment or at any time during the tenure. Services are terminated forthwith if documents are fake or information has been suppressed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Hard copy of the online application form with the same passport size photograph affixed (persons already in service bring it signed by the employer). Self-attested copies of all educational/professional qualification certificates (degrees and DMCs with conversion formula of CGPA/OGPA) and the experience certificate. Latest reserve category certificate issued by the competent authority, and Punjab Domicile/Punjab Residence Certificate for reserve category. Backward Class claimants bring the latest valid BC certificate with an income certificate; EWS and BC claimants submit a photocopy of the latest valid certificate. Originals of all certificates, degrees, DMCs and testimonials, and supporting documents for marks claimed in the Score Card. 7 copies of the list of publications. A No Objection Certificate from the present employer, or an undertaking on the prescribed format on the University website ( http://online.gndu.ac.in/career-with-us.aspx ), for those already in service who did not apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GNDU Assistant Professor 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration/submission of application is 1 December 2026. Registration opened on 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. When is the GNDU Assistant Professor walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 at 11:30 A.M. in the Office of Dean, Academic Affairs, Senate Hall Building, Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar. Candidates must report at least an hour earlier.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GNDU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject, plus NET (UGC/CSIR/SLET/SET) or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations. The specialization requires a Master's degree (Religious Studies) with 55% marks having NET or a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GNDU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: UGC NET qualified candidates get Rs. 45,000 per month fixed, and non-NET qualified candidates get Rs. 35,000 per month fixed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: For one subject, SC/ST/PWD pay Rs. 590 and all other categories Rs. 1180, including GST. For more than one subject/campus the fees are Rs. 1180 and Rs. 2360. SC/ST/PWD candidates who are not Punjab domicile pay Rs. 1180.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the GNDU Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Apply online only through www.gndu.ac.in, filling the Score Card Proforma and paying the fee online. No post, email, fax or CV deposit is accepted. Bring the printout to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post is on a contractual basis for the session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q8. Will call letters be sent for the interview?
faq.answer: No separate call letters will be issued. Candidates attend as per the schedule on the University website.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is a No Objection Certificate needed for candidates in service?
faq.answer: They bring a No Objection Certificate from the present employer or give an undertaking on the University format. Candidates may be allowed to appear without an NOC on the undertaking, with no extension in joining time if selected.
